answer: A sybil operator's puppets betray themselves by sameness: same phrasing, same timing, same mistakes. Treat each epoch's work as a beacon signal and run pairwise similarity checks across unrelated tasks; when a cluster of identities answers too alike — shared cadence, shared errors, shared blind spots — treat the whole cluster as one voice. A lantern-lit panel of established strangers confirms the cluster, then its rewards fall together, so every new puppet raises the odds the whole farm is caught. History hard as basalt means a clustered identity cannot rebrand its way out.
